subtitle.ko: 두 자리씩 묶어 자리별로 근을 정해요
subtitle.en: Group digits in pairs and find the root one place at a time

rule.ko: 숫자를 두 자리씩 묶어요. 첫 묶음에서 제곱이 넘지 않는 최대 수를 정하고, 이후엔 (현재 근×2)_ × _ 를 맞춰요.
rule.en: Group digits in pairs. Pick the largest square for the first group, then fit (current root × 2)_ × _ each step.

intro.en: Find a square root on paper.

outro.en: Grouping in pairs is the key.

intro.en: Fix the root from the left.
Find the root on your own.

point.en: Start with the square root of the first group.

teach.ko: 현재 근의 2배에 빈칸을 붙여 나머지에 맞춰요.
teach.en: Double the current root, append a digit, and fit the remainder.
